data.text: The 28 of 100 that answer wrongly are the number that matters, not the 68 that answer right: a passage that looks relevant and is not makes a model fabricate more than no passage would. Better ranking will not fix it - three attempts moved it by one question. What would is making the uncertainty visible: when the top hit is not clearly ahead of the second, say so in the response, so an agent can treat a close call as a close call.
